about: Vespera (the user, 2026-11-20, Attachments/Vespera), a new main character, a Guerreira with mace and shield, from seven 1080p videos: the idle (Vespera Idle), the attack and the special (VesperaATTSpecial), the walks left / right and up / down, the hit, the fall, the turn to her back. One scale per video, every clip's light matched to the ATTSpecial video's standing frames (light studio). Alta = every frame at the video's own size; Média / Leve at ~610 px.
figureNote: a first value, the user's to judge in play: Isolde's and Neera's height (2.66 units), hair top to boots
scaleNote: measured 2026-11-20 (hair top to boots, on the head's own columns): idle 1661 px, att 907 px, left 1522 px, right 1522 px, up 1365 px, down 1436 px, hit 1545 px, fall 858 px, turn 1433 px; one figurePx per video (per view in the walk videos)
